title: Bluebell Crossing Clinic - Morning Queue Update
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Is it just me or is the clinic line actually moving before 10 AM? I walked by at half past eight and it was already at the door, not wrapped around the corner.

Not just you! The new board showing estimated wait times is a game-saver. And the separate window for repeat prescriptions? Brilliant. I can now: 1) drop my kid at the co-op, 2) swing by the clinic, and 3) still get to my appointment with time to spare. It used to be a whole morning affair.
Seconding that. Picked up my mother’s heart medicine yesterday. In and out the side window in three minutes. Billie and the team really sorted it.
Thank you, everyone. It’s a team effort. The board helps manage expectations, and moving the script pick-ups has cleared the main queue significantly. We’re glad it’s working for you.
It absolutely is. The co-op parents have noticed. Less stress about running late means fewer rescheduled appointments, which is better for everyone. Well done, Billie.
